snippet.title: Console and Physical Edition Announcement Trailer | Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
snippet.description:
We heard you loud and clear! We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and today, we’re beyond excited to officially reveal the release dates for our digital and physical editions for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate. Here's the key dates for your diary: 

- PlayStation 5 & PlayStation 4 Digital Release on May 20th, 2025 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011976/
- Xbox Series X/S & Xbox One Digital Release on June 24th, 2025
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-splintered-fate/9nm22mrrmx6z
- Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate Deluxe Edition for PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X and Nintendo Switch on August 26th, 2025
- Limited Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate Pipin’ Hot Collector’s Edition also on August 26th, 2025

Pre-order your physical editions at all major retailers, and wishlist the game on PlayStation and Xbox today. Jump into the portal of your choice!

For more information, check out the Super Evil Megacorp blog here: https://superevilmegacorp.com/news/
